Item Class: Misc Map Items
Rarity: Currency
Inscribed Ultimatum
--------
Challenge: Stand in the Stone Circles
Area Level: 83
Requires Sacrifice: Chaos Orb x20
Reward: Doubles sacrificed Currency
--------
Choking Miasma III
(A large and fast cloud that deals Chaos Damage over Time will follow you)
Raging Dead
(Skulls will appear that spit Fire if you remain near them)
Razor Dance
(Blades will periodically appear and fly at you, applying Corrupted Blood on Hit)
Reduced Recovery
(60% Reduced Life, Mana, and Energy Shield Recovery Rate)
Less Cooldown Recovery
(Cooldowns take five times longer to recharge)
Escalating Damage Taken
(For the remainder of the encounter, damage taken will slowly increase by 2% per second, up to 50%)
Overwhelming Monsters
(Monster Hits Overwhelm all Physical Damage Reduction)
10% increased Monster Damage
30% more Monster Life
--------
Can be used in a personal map device to open portals to the Trialmaster's Domain and attempt his challenge. Portals will close once the challenge begins. While viewing your Atlas, Right-click this item to pinpoint its location.
